notes: Base catalogue: en-gb locale (same base as prior Home-Decor pass, see notes/150.md). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Site has a real Clearance-style taxonomy: main nav shows a 'SALE' section (data-cy hamburger entries) and sitemap.xml lists three campaign PLPs: /en-gb/sale/sale/all-items, /en-gb/sale/sale/tableware, and /en-gb/outlet/outlet/all-items; a fourth, /en-gb/sale/sale/home-decor, exists (HTTP 200) but is not sitemap-indexed. 'Outlet' is a direct target term per brief and qualifies outright; 'Sale' is the ambiguous generic-promo term the brief warns about, but the distinction turned out moot: all four pages (Sale/All items, Sale/Tableware, Sale/Home decor, Outlet/All items) currently render the SSR'd, server-side text 'THE CAMPAIGN HAS ENDED' with zero products/tiles and no Coveo grid populated - confirmed both in raw HTTP-fetched HTML (tier 1, 'campaign has ended' string present server-side, no JS needed) and via a Playwright render of the two /all-items pages (tile_count 0, no '<N> results' text anywhere in rendered body). This is a genuine, currently-empty clearance/outlet concept, not an absent one: the site clearly HAS a Clearance/Outlet merchandising structure in its taxonomy, it is simply between campaigns at the time of this extraction (2026-09-08). Per brief, zero-product listings are dropped rather than emitted as qty:0 rows. No other clearance/outlet/final-sale/last-chance/end-of-line pages were found in nav, footer, or sitemap search of /en-gb/(sale|outlet|clearance|final-sale|last-chance)/ path patterns.
